WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_ambictemp,
    AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment se
  INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) as mean_of_avg_imgcount
  FROM status_avgs
)
SELECT 
  sa.entrystat,
  sa.avg_ambictemp,
  sa.avg_imgcount,
  sa.avg_imgcount - om.mean_of_avg_imgcount
FROM status_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
